slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: regions
slots.about: where a chart can be from: id, name

slots.name: charts
slots.about: the stacked charts in order: id, name

slots.name: items
slots.about: chart rows: id, chart, region, name, credit (a short second line), rank, last_rank (0 when new)

slots.name: top_count
slots.about: rows shown per chart before More

slots.name: more_word
slots.about: the chart's More button while short

slots.name: less_word
slots.about: the chart's button while it shows every row

slots.name: region_word
slots.about: spoken before the region on the picker

slots.name: up_word
slots.about: spoken for a rise, before the steps

slots.name: down_word
slots.about: spoken for a drop, before the steps

slots.name: new_word
slots.about: shown and spoken for a row that was not in the last chart

slots.name: empty_text
slots.about: what shows when the region has no chart yet

empty.shows: empty when the region has no chart; a chart with no rows hides

attention.shows: a move icon under every rank (rise, drop, same) or the new word, each spoken, never colour alone

fallback.shows: a chart with top_count rows or fewer has no More

labels.more: more_word or less_word and the chart name
labels.row: rank, name, credit and the move in words

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, shrink and swap

notes: Ranks come from the data (a chart publishes them); the move compares rank with last_rank. Picking a region closes the picker and every open chart.
